verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's experimentation docs state that experiments can run on data from an external warehouse such as Snowflake. Its metrics docs show metrics built from your own custom events, including numeric metrics, covering both the warehouse and ingested-event paths in the story. The warehouse path rests on a single sentence, with no detail on how metrics are defined from warehouse tables. missing for 10: detailed documentation of defining metrics on warehouse tables (SQL/table mapping, supported warehouses beyond Snowflake), independent or hands-on corroboration of warehouse-native metrics.
